newsitem.title: UK: IPE Brent drifts lower in quiet,featureless market.
newsitem.headline: IPE Brent drifts lower in quiet,featureless market.

text.p: IPE Brent futures drifted lower in a quiet, featureless market on Friday afternoon, traders said.
June IPE Brent was trading five cents lower at $18.36 a barrel at 1451 GMT, while gas oil was $1.25 higher at $166.00 a tonne.
Prices rose on Thursday on reports that U.N. staff in northern Iraq had been arrested by a Kurdish group. The United Nations later said the report was untrue.
The rumours sparked concerns that the oil-for-food deal between Iraq and the United Nations could be under threat.
"Most of Thursday's gains were on the Iraq rumours which turned out to be untrue so maybe now we're seeing more realistic levels," said one trader.
He added that as long as IPE Brent remained above $18 and NYMEX crude above $19.70 the market would remain supportive.
